eyebrow: SQL Server Performance Tuning · Chapter Ten
subtitle: Lesson 49 · Capstone

code:
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX
  IX_Orders_CustomerID_OrderDate
ON dbo.Orders (CustomerID, OrderDate DESC)
INCLUDE (OrderStatus, OrderTotal, ShipDate);
caption: Key = seek + sort order. INCLUDE = everything else the SELECT needs.

code:
DROP INDEX IX_Orders_CustomerID
  ON dbo.Orders;

The new index seeks on everything the
old one could, and covers the query.

Leaving both = paying write-maintenance
cost twice for zero remaining benefit.
caption: Part of the deliberate change, not optional cleanup.
